text:
nina: Quick brief 10am sync: launch in two weeks, need a small benchmark visual pack + inbound routing diagram for the site. Deliverables: hero banner (1200x628), slide hero (1920x1080), three microtiles (600x400), single-page PDF template, and a CSV mapping for webhooks. Keep the message: simple latency vs cost tradeoff. Deadline: first comps Mon EOD. :calendar:

rolf: Thanks. Can you drop the data and any visual examples? Also confirm brand colors and fonts.

nina: Data sheet: https://files.redwood/launch/pack_metrics.csv. Use latency on x-axis, cost on y-axis, add small inset sparkline for per-token volatility. Brand colors: Primary Teal #0DB1A3 for latency, Accent Amber #FFB84D for cost. Typeface: Inter for body, Inter-SemiBold for headers. Provide light/dark logo variants and 24px clearspace.

sam: Design notes: microtiles should have a 1-line insight + bold metric. Provide alt text drafts and AA contrast checks. Motion allowed: tiny SVG draw for sparkline only, max 6s. Export requirements: PNGs at 2x, slide in 16:9. Mobile-first layout please.

nina: For inbound routing, push these tags on submit: source, plan, intent. Routing rules: hosted -> marketing-nurture, dedicated -> sales-queue, private -> partner-engage. Include a branching diagram and a CSV example in the ticket.

rolf: Example CSV mapping I'd add:```form_field,webhook_key
utm_source,source
plan_select,plan
interest_area,intent```Also include a mock webhook payload (without keys) and note to strip secrets.

sam: Copy. I'll do two hero variants (short/long headline) + microtiles grid. Need CTA short options please.

nina: CTA A: "Try Hosted API"; CTA B: "Book Dedicated Demo"; CTA C: "Download one-pager". Headline guidance: Variant A = 5 words, Variant B = up to 9 words. Keep copy punchy.

legal: Quick flag: if we reference third-party models, include attribution line. Avoid absolute performance claims without source citation. We'll review comps once uploaded.

sam: Creating ticket DESIGN-5221 "Bench visuals + inbound routing diagram" 1 assignee: sam, due: 1777843200. Will upload Figma link and PNG exports by Mon EOD.

nina: Great. Please tag layers for dev export and include alt text for each image in the Figma file. If blocked, ping me here. :pray:
